name: Italian Beef Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

components.name: Meatballs in Tomato Sauce

ingredients.name: Soft white bread, crusts removed (about 1 lightly packed cup, diced)
Fresh parsley, finely chopped (about ¼ cup)

steps: Grate the onion into a mixing bowl and fold in pieces of bread. Leave briefly until the crumbs soften.
Add minced beef, egg, garlic, Parmesan, parsley and seasoning. Mix just until cohesive so the meatballs remain tender.
Roll approximately 20 equal meatballs. Brown in a wide oiled pan in batches, turning to colour the outside.
Lift the meatballs out. Soften the diced onion in the same pan and add garlic for 30 seconds.
Add passata, water and dried herbs. Simmer for 8 minutes and scrape the pan base for flavour.
Return meatballs to the sauce; simmer gently for 12–15 minutes until cooked through (ground meat reaches 71°C).
Divide meatballs and sauce equally into five containers. For a full pasta dinner, add a separately calculated starch portion.

notes: Draft — needs Mirna review: not kitchen-tested yet; quantities, macros and cooked yields are estimates.
Each meatball is packed with its share of the tomato sauce.
Freezer: Freeze meatballs submerged in sauce.
Keeps 3–4 days in the fridge (≤4°C); refrigerate within 2 hours (1 hour above 32°C) in shallow containers, freeze portions for later in the week, and reheat to at least 74°C.
